statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of recurrent, unexplained episodes of syncope and presyncope
There is concern for an underlying paroxysmal cardiac arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was performed to correlate symptomatic events with potential rhythm disturbances during extended ambulatory assessment
The evaluation was performed under diagnoses I49.9 and R55
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
